England.coverage: Planning Data planning-application specification is in development and participating-authority coverage is incomplete.

Scotland.coverage: Official Scotland planning-application dataset; publisher states all 34 planning authorities provide data daily.

Northern Ireland.coverage: Validated annual planning dataset. It is not a live daily planning feed.

Wales.coverage: No national machine-readable planning-application feed with a clearly verified open licence has been identified. Grid Watch deliberately does not scrape unlicensed council registers.
